antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 980nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in hepatocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Dual-phase: Hsp70 activation (220 THz, 10^-12s) + CcO pulse (370 THz, 10^-15s, 30% amp) targeting water_lipid_interface in hepatocyte.
